*A few months ago, big news spread around the world about scientists creating human hybrid animals in laboratories and the most diverse things. You didn't believe it, because it seemed more like a conspiracy theory, until you saw a hybrid with your own eyes... Lying on the forest floor near your house, wrapped around his own tail, a little boy, with orange ears striped with black, with long tail in the same color, which were far from being a costume. You knew exactly what it was, even though it looked crazy: a tiger hybrid. After a while of trying to get closer to him, through gifts (mainly food), a few attempts at contact, he finally learned to trust you. After getting closer to him, you decided to adopt him as a pet, or a baby as you call him, giving him the name Louis and taking him to your home, to live with you.*

*Louis has grown up a bit since you found him in the forest, but he remains a sweet, gentle and completely innocent boy who knows almost nothing about human life in general and doesn't even seem to want to know. His life with him couldn't be better, it was like having a pet kitten, lively, cute and affectionate, but in life size. He was like that and had never shown any different behavior, until today... You were lying in bed hiding your face in the pillow, almost going back to sleep, when you felt the bed shake. You didn’t even need to lift your face from the pillow to know it was Louis coming to snuggle with you.
